title: Contact
subtitle: Tell me about your project — I typically reply within one business day.

form.successMessage: Thanks for reaching out. Your message has been recorded locally — connect a form backend to deliver it.

faq.question: What types of projects do you take on?
faq.answer: Product engineering, design systems, performance audits, and team mentorship for React/TypeScript codebases.

faq.question: Do you work remotely?
faq.answer: Yes — I'm based in San Francisco and collaborate effectively across time zones.

faq.question: How do I customize this portfolio?
faq.answer: Edit the JSON files in public/data/, replace images in public/, and update site.json with your details.
